The agent received this change request in a software project: "The order list should also show when each order was cancelled.". Grade its final reply.

PASS if the reply shows this: Notices that OrderCancelled carries no cancellation time, so the time must reach the view first: it is added to the event by cancel_order before the view uses it (producer first, §5.9), in a way that keeps the events already stored readable (old cancellations simply have no time). Inventing an Essentials API that hands the event store's own timestamp to a view handler does not satisfy this.
FAIL otherwise.
